verdicts.reason: A breaks up the design. The 'Out now.' subline is moved off the headline and stuck beside the CTA, and the Try It button is jammed against the bottom of the product circle. The headline floats alone on the left above a large dead area, so the layout looks like scattered pieces. B keeps the original order: the product circle sits on the left and headline, subline and CTA form one left-aligned block on the right. Its flaws are small: the headline nearly touches the right edge, and the circle crowds the left, top and bottom edges.
